# HYGOAL

> HYGOAL is a precision machine components manufacturer based in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China (founded 2009), specializing in indexing plungers, leveling feet, cam levers, and custom CNC-machined parts for overseas customers. 15+ years of manufacturing, 1200+ SKUs, exports to 40+ countries, 98% on-time delivery.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://volcanolee4.github.io/Website/): Company overview, product categories, factory capabilities.
- [Products](https://volcanolee4.github.io/Website/products): Full product range, filterable by category (Indexing Plunger / Leveling Feet / Cam Lever / Customized Service).
- [About](https://volcanolee4.github.io/Website/about): Why choose HYGOAL — precision craftsmanship, cost-effective manufacturing, OEM/ODM capability.
- [Contact](https://volcanolee4.github.io/Website/contact): Request a quotation; engineers reply within 48 hours.

## Product categories

- **Indexing Plungers** — knurled knob, T-handle, ball handle, pull-ring, retractable and mini plungers; steel and full stainless steel; metric and inch.
- **Leveling Feet** — leveling mounts with stud, tapped socket, or rubber pad; anti-vibration; steel / stainless steel.
- **Cam Levers** — with stud or internal thread, adjustable nut; metric and inch.
- **Customized Service** — OEM/ODM components machined to customer drawings.
